strips.title: A new doorbell without a plan: in real life

panels.head: Before you buy
panels.text: Open the old chime and read the transformer label: volts and VA.

panels.head: Storage first
panels.text: Built-in memory or a microSD card, so clips save with no monthly fee.

panels.head: Day 30
panels.text: Trials end. If clips stop saving, the doorbell needed a plan all along.

panels.head: Tune it
panels.text: Narrow the motion zone so the street does not drain the battery.
